output.text: Welcome, seeker of stars, to the Sleepless Observatory—where time stands still and the sky holds its breath. Four sealed drawers lie before you, each hiding a fragment of a forgotten sky chart. Before dawn breaks, you must restore the celestial map so the keeper may find the missing constellation. The stars are waiting. Begin.
